location.label: Google/Tuike Finland Muhos — Leppiniemi/Pyhänsivu, Finland
location.geometry: Use EIA Figure 3-1, PDF page 28 / printed page 27, as the layout reference. The 571 ha planning envelope is not a measured forest or exact clearance polygon supplied by this packet.
location.baseline: Forested and peatland project setting; not every hectare is established as intact forest.

project_area_ha.note: Planning envelope; not cleared or sealed area.

reported_cleared_area_ha.note: Approximate clearance confirmed by a company spokesperson in Yle reporting; not our GIS measurement or a tree count.

planned_halls.note: Planned count; no verified footprint, floor area or IT capacity.

drainage_va1_va2_ha.note: Combined VA1 and VA2 only. Not the whole catchment, clearance or project envelope. VA3 area is not supplied in the cited document.

new_ditch_length_km.note: Proposed new ditches described as largely already built, not a survey proving the whole 8.9 km was completed.

preliminary_maximum_total_water_need_m3_.note: 2025 programme estimate including process and domestic water. Not measured use, net evaporation or the final selected air-cooling demand.

water_cooling_evaporation_fraction.note: TVE1 only, fraction of river-pumped cooling water. Never apply it to total process plus domestic water.

water_cooling_return_fraction.note: TVE1 return to Oulujoki, subject to suitable treatment and design. Do not use the SF sanitary blowdown route.

illustrative_cooling_makeup_l.note: An accounting example, not a daily plant demand or currently operating equipment.

year_days_for_equivalent.note: Converts an annual upper estimate into an even-day equivalent, not peak or actual daily demand.

event.selection: Largest positive daily depth in the frozen August 2026 regional station query: a selected strong summer-rain example, with no assigned return period.
event.surface_assumption: Thawed-surface rainfall illustration only. Snowmelt and frozen-ground runoff require different modelling.

operation.default_display: Conditional planning futures, not an operating Google campus or a confirmed final technology.
operation.air_option: TVE2: air coolers and chillers, with two closed loops in the 2025 programme; no verified annual site-water quantity.
operation.river_option: TVE1: river-fed evaporative cooling; use the 70/30 split only on an explicitly normalized cooling example.
operation.municipal_cooling_capacity: The EIA programme says the local waterworks and aquifer cannot deliver the cooling requirement for the river-water option. It describes a separate intake/treatment solution, not household supply cuts.
operation.reported_intent: Kaleva reports intended air cooling. Final selected design and annual water demand have not been verified in primary material obtained for this packet.

boundaries: The 571 ha, 330 ha and 275 ha figures have different scopes; do not add or subtract them to invent land-cover or catchment partitions.
The weather replay yields gross precipitation volumes only. No SF/SJ curve number, runoff coefficient or soil group is transferred to peat, fine-grained soil, black shale or winter conditions.
Future construction, opening and operation are conditional. The present case does not establish completed buildings or operating water use.
No numerical pollution, flooding, fish mortality, wolf displacement, household shortage or infrastructure expansion is predicted.
No SF cooling intensity, CoC 4 or sanitary discharge route is imported. TVE1 normalized fractions do not apply to the 20 million m³ process-plus-domestic figure.
